regionalHunger.measure: SWS involuntary ('Total') hunger: % of families who experienced hunger at least once in the past three months
regionalHunger.geography: SWS areas: NCR, Balance Luzon (contains CALABARZON), Visayas, Mindanao. No province or municipality is surveyed separately.
notes: Respondents were household heads until December 2024 and adults from April 2025; there is no bridging round.
The commissioned March 2025 (Stratbase) voter round is excluded.

foodPrices.definition: Food-price squeeze (FPD) = province food CPI YoY minus all-items CPI YoY (PSA, 2018=100); > 0 means food prices are rising faster than general prices. An economic-access indicator, not a hunger measure.
foodPrices.linkToHunger: No measurable link to SWS hunger (concurrent rho 0.14, p .59; leading Holm p = 1).

localEvidence: No measured food-insecurity figure has been published for individual provinces after FNRI's 2021 survey round, or for any city or municipality (SWS reports regions only; CBMS 2024 LGU results are not public). The province values on the map are model forecast probabilities, not measured rates; city and municipal values are relative priorities within each province, not forecasts.

dataFreshness.note: PSA releases a month's CPI about the 5th of the following month

forecastStatus: food-insecurity forecast: e168-lgbm-1.0 approved by the owner-defined acceptance (/api/v1/final/food-insecurity/outlook); SWS hunger forecast: validation pending, not public (see /api/v1/final/model-registry)
